items.caption:
Why can't I remember my dreams? What sleep science says.
Your brain enters REM several times a night and most dreaming happens then, but the sleeping brain is bad at saving new memories. People who wake briefly more often tend to remember more.

items.caption:
A tanker, a reef, and too little sleep.
The NTSB found the Exxon Valdez ran aground in 1989 partly because the third mate was fatigued and overworked; it also cited the captain's alcohol impairment and a crew that was not rested.
